tasks.prompt: Read-only: Which file defines validateReleaseArtifacts, and what does it validate? Give the file path and one concise sentence. Do not edit files.
Read-only: Where does this plugin choose between BB host-file snapshots and local ripgrep for exact search? Name the implementation file and summarize the routing rule. Do not edit files.

metrics.correct: Answer names an expected file and contains all required answer terms, case-insensitively.
metrics.nativeToolCalls: Count completed Code Intelligence tool calls in the thread event stream.
metrics.shellSearches: Count command-execution events containing rg, grep, find, fd, ag, or ack.
metrics.toolCalls: Count all completed tool calls and command executions.
metrics.durationMs: Elapsed time from client/turn/requested to the final completed agent message.

comparability: Every run uses the same pinned repository commit, provider, model, permission mode, prompts, and isolated BB version. The only intended variable is whether Code Intelligence is installed.
